title: Voice Over Artist
description_html:
We are one of the leading tech-driven media and entertainment companies, producing uplifting content in 17 languages for audiences of all ages. Known for the award-winning digital publisher boredpanda.com and the Crafty Panda DIY channel, we fight the worldâs boredom at scale - reaching 160 million site views per month and 62 billion video views per year. Our team consists of around 350 creative professionals from 36 countries, with 2 offices in Vilnius, Lithuania.

Spike, the global animated series, is searching for talented voice actors to bring its characters to life! Our YouTube channel has reached over 1 billion views, entertaining children worldwide with universal, character-driven stories. We're casting our two lead roles: Spike, an imaginative, curious, and fearless 7-year-old whose creativity turns everyday moments into adventures; and Sparkle, his confident, attention-loving 5Â½-year-old sister with unmistakable main-character energy. Additionally, we are seeking versatile utility players who can perform multiple recurring characters - from the know-it-all giraffe girl, Poem, and the scared but loyal elephant boy, Muddles, to the bully rhino twins, Storm and Thunder, and the local mad scientist lion, Professor Roar, to name a few. Plus, there are loving parents, friends, foes, and all the colorful citizens that make Spike's world so vibrant.

What You Will Do:

  • Bring recurring characters to life with expressive performances that match the show's playful and energetic tone;
  • Help shape memorable voices and personalities for the faces of a global IP;
  • Deliver engaging voice performances that support clear storytelling in fast-paced 3â5 minute episodes;
  • Perform dialogue that enhances visual comedy and elevates emotional moments;
  • Maintain consistent character voices and performances across multiple episodes;
  • Take direction well, adjusting pacing, emotion, and delivery as needed;
  • Record clean, broadcast-quality audio from a professional home studio;
  • Attend directed recording sessions via remote call, if required;
  • Work efficiently to deliver recordings on schedule as part of Spike's consistent weekly production cadence;
  • Collaborate with directors and sound supervisors to create polished, world-class voice performances for each episode.

What We Expect:

  • Professional voice acting experience in animation, games, children's media, dubbing, or similar productions;
  • Strong character acting skills with distinctive, believable, and consistent voices;
  • Strong acting instincts and an understanding of how voice performance supports visual storytelling;
  • Ability to take direction while bringing your own creative ideas to deliver the strongest performance possible;
  • Clear diction, vocal control, and emotionally authentic performances;
  • Fluency in English and mastery of American accents;
  • Spike is worldwide, so an understanding of globally accessible performances that communicate character and emotion across cultures;
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, digital-first production environment;
  • A reliable home recording setup capable of delivering broadcast-quality audio;
  • Professionalism, responsiveness, and the ability to meet deadlines while collaborating effectively with the creative team.

Compensation: 40-120 eur/gross per episode.

Please note that selected candidates will be contacted to audition for their desired roles.
